{{Quote|The Baragwins' native planet is unknown, even to the Baragwins themselves. Colonies of these aliens have been moving about the galaxy for so long that their ancient history has been shrouded in myth, and they have a difficult time separating fact from fiction. Instead, Baragwins consider themselves native to the planet on which they were born.|The first draft of ''The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life''|<ref name="Aliens — Enemies and Allies">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref>}}
'''Old Barag'''<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" /> was a [[planet]]<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> located in the [[Old Barag system/Legends|Old Barag system]] of the [[Epsi Collective/Legends|Epsi Collective]], within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[11,591 BBY]], the [[Baragwin/Legends|Baragwin]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was attacked by the [[Pius Dea]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Fifteenth Pius Dea Crusade]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" /> By the publication of ''[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life]]''{{'s}} first draft<ref name="Aliens — Enemies and Allies" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Chronology note">According to ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'', the [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was discovered two [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the publication of ''[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life]]''{{'s}} first draft. As ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' dates this event to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]], it can be determined that this manuscript was published in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> Old Barag had long since been forgotten, even by the Baragwin themselves.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" />

==Behind the scenes==
Old Barag was first mentioned without identification in ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'', a [[1995]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] supplement for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Aliens — Enemies and Allies" />
